command_execution_path.evidence: TestModel:Update reads BackQuote and opens TestCommandView when it is not already open
TestCommandView:Update handles Return; OnExecuteBntClick calls ExecuteCmd with the input text
TestCommandView:ExecuteCmd trims input, splits on spaces, takes token 1 as command, then scans ECommand by Cmd
Matched ECommand entry invokes cmdDef:ExecuteFunc(list); each TestCommandDefinition entry owns its ExecuteFunc implementation

confirmed_gate_code.remote_extension: TestModel calls CS.LuaTestHelper.DownloadTestWindowCustomConfig(userId, callback) on main-scene entry when no custom config is present
confirmed_gate_code.remote_code_execution: TestWindowV2:LoadCustomConfig obtains custom Lua text from CS.LuaTestHelper.GetTestWindowCustomConfig(), passes it to load(), and executes the returned function when compilation succeeds

interpretation_limits: 存在于安装包只证明测试代码已打包，不证明当前构建或账号已启用。
按钮名称、回调和风险标签来自代码静态线索；需要继续解析 TestWindowV2 配置选择、自定义配置覆盖和具体回调副作用。
带有账户、服务器、支付、删库、跳关、资源修改或重启线索的入口不应在正式账号上试点。
远端自定义 Lua 的来源、签名/完整性校验、权限控制、失败策略及持久化边界尚未由此索引确认。
